Package index

Charts

Start a chart. Each shortcut is the equivalent pipeline of set_*() calls, ready to pipe further.

arc_chart()
Start a chart
arc_bar()
Bar chart
arc_col()
Column chart
arc_scatter()
Scatterplot
arc_line()
Line chart
ArcChart()
A chart specification

Mapping

Bind columns and text to a chart.

set_type()
Set a chart's type
set_x() set_y()
Map a column to a chart's x or y field
set_stat()
Set a chart's statistical transformation
set_color()
Map a column to colour
set_labs()
Set a chart's labels

Scales and orientation

How the axes are scaled and which way the chart is drawn.

set_axis()
Set an axis
set_flipped()
Swap a chart's axes

Rendering

Turn a chart into an htmlwidget, in a document or in Shiny.

as_widget()
Convert a chart to an htmlwidget
as_chart_layer()
Build a feature layer from a data frame
arcgis_chart()
Render an ArcGIS chart
arcgisChartOutput() renderArcgisChart()
Shiny bindings for arcgis_chart
